name: remnote-local
description: Use a locally running RemNote MCP Server from Claude Desktop or Cowork without a public HTTPS tunnel.
long_description: RemNote Local is a Claude Desktop extension that exposes RemNote MCP tools over stdio and forwards calls to a local remnote-mcp-server Streamable HTTP endpoint. It can also be used by Claude Cowork in Claude Desktop when desktop extensions are enabled. Start remnote-mcp-server and keep the RemNote Automation Bridge plugin connected before using the tools.

tools.name: remnote_create_note
tools.description: Create a new note in RemNote with optional content, parent, and exact tag Rem IDs. Supports hierarchical markdown, flashcard syntax (e.g. "- Term :: Definition"), and exact inline Rem references as [[id:<remId>]]. At least one of title or content must be provided. Recommended preflight once per session: remnote_status.

tools.name: remnote_search
tools.description: Search the RemNote knowledge base. Supports cursor paging through hasMore/nextCursor. For whole-KB orientation, prefer contentMode="structured" with view="compact", depth=1, and childLimit=500. Request ancestorDepth when hierarchy context matters.

tools.name: remnote_search_by_tag
tools.description: Find notes by exact tag Rem ID. Supports cursor paging through hasMore/nextCursor. Default resultMode="context" returns resolved ancestor context targets with matchedRems; resultMode="tagged" returns directly tagged Rems with context metadata. Request ancestorDepth to include parent-first ancestors on both context results and matchedRems.

tools.name: remnote_read_note
tools.description: Read a specific note from RemNote by its Rem ID. For hierarchy traversal, prefer contentMode="structured" and start shallow (depth=1, childLimit=500), then deepen only selected branches. Request ancestorDepth when placement context matters.

tools.name: remnote_get_media
tools.description: Retrieve a RemNote-managed local image as MCP-native image content. First call remnote_read_note with includeMediaMetadata=true, then pass the returned remId, field, and mediaId. Requires bridge capability media.images.v1. External URL retrieval is not supported.

tools.name: remnote_list_children
tools.description: List direct child Rems under a parent without rendering a subtree. Use for cheap hierarchy traversal; page with nextCursor when hasMore is true.

tools.name: remnote_update_note
tools.description: Update note metadata in RemNote. Use this tool for title changes only. The title supports exact Rem references as [[id:<remId>]].

tools.name: remnote_set_document_status
tools.description: Preview or set whether an existing Rem is marked as a document. Uses dryRun=true by default, preserves Rem ID, children, parent, tags, and concept/card status, and requires write operations to be enabled.

tools.name: remnote_move_note
tools.description: Safely move an existing Rem and its subtree under a new parent. Defaults to dryRun=true; pass dryRun=false only after user approval. expectedOldParentRemId rejects stale move proposals.

tools.name: remnote_insert_children
tools.description: Insert new child Rems under a parent at a deterministic position without replacing existing children. Use this for tag description nodes and hierarchy maintenance.

tools.name: remnote_replace_children
tools.description: Replace all direct children under a parent Rem. This is destructive because existing child Rem IDs are removed and may be blocked by bridge policy.

tools.name: remnote_update_tags
tools.description: Add or remove tags from a note by exact tag Rem IDs. Use this for production tagging workflows to avoid ambiguous name lookup.

tools.name: remnote_set_property
tools.description: Set or clear a tag/table property value on a Rem by exact IDs. The bridge verifies the property belongs to the supplied tag/table Rem, adds the tag idempotently, then writes the property value. For select properties, pass the option Rem ID as value.kind="rem_reference".

tools.name: remnote_append_journal
tools.description: Append content to today's daily document in RemNote with optional exact tag Rem IDs. Recommended preflight once per session: remnote_status.

tools.name: remnote_get_playbook
tools.description: Get an operations playbook for MCP agents: status-first recommendation, navigation presets, content-mode guidance, and write-safety decision tree.

tools.name: remnote_status
tools.description: Check bridge connection health, compatibility warnings, and write-policy capabilities. Recommended once per session before write operations.

tools.name: remnote_read_table
tools.description: Read an Advanced Table from RemNote by exact title or Rem ID. Returns the table schema (columns with property types) and row data (cell values). Use this when you need structured tabular data. For simple tag-based queries without table structure, prefer remnote_search_by_tag.
